page.overview:
Who is Finn?

Finn Mertens, also known as Winterworld Finn, is an alternate version of Finn from the Winterworld universe. He makes his only appearance in "The Bear and the Rose". He is seen riding a Slime Creature with the Winterworld version of Slime Princess, approaching the Winterworld Candy Kingdom. After their arrival, he and Slime Princess instantly make out.

Finn physically resembles his original counterpart from the Fionna and Cake series, but he seems to be slightly chubbier. Like the original Finn, he keeps his hair and beard long, but they seem to be entirely covered in slime, giving them a greenish appearance. Finn's right arm is replaced with a long, stretchy green slime arm. Unlike the original Finn, he does not appear to have any scars.

Finn wears only a white, tattered loincloth around his waist. He also carries a red battle axe with spikes on the guard.
